data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 和室矮桌的夜间练字
data.description: 洗完温泉澡后的夏夜和室里，蕾娜换上轻爽透气的晴空蓝网眼吊带短裤套，赤脚趴在榻榻米矮桌边，一手托腮、一手认真抄写着新学的日语词汇与穗织俗语。额前金发随着微风轻垂，她写完一行便得意地举起本子请你打分。
data.location: 亮着纸罩台灯的温泉旅馆夏夜和室
data.action: 趴在榻榻米矮桌边手持圆珠笔练字，得意举起笔记本展示
data.lighting: 和纸台灯温润暖光照亮榻榻米与晴空蓝轻爽睡衣
data.camera: 斜俯中景，摊开的日语笔记本与凉麦茶入画
data.promptProse: Stretched out comfortably on the tatami beside a low wooden table under a warm paper lamp, Lena props herself on one elbow and lifts her study notebook to show off newly written Japanese words. Her sky-blue mesh racerback camisole and side-striped sleep boyshorts look breezy and athletic in the summer evening calm.
data.animaCaption: Lying on the tatami by a low lamplit table, she proudly holds up her language notebook with a cheerful smile.
